title: Grateful Dead Live at County Coliseum on 1973-11-23
lineage: CD -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Reel Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard capture of a Texas‑thunder El Paso show featuring smoking Eyes of the World, Jack Straw and Big River.
ai_review.review: The recording is a crystal‑clear soundboard mix that fans describe as “off the charts” and superior in balance. The concert delivers high‑energy first‑set fireworks with Jack Straw and Sugaree, while the second set keeps the vibe loose yet powerful, highlighted by an unforgettable Eyes of the World. Overall the performance feels like classic ’73 Texas thunder.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer stars (average 4.4), strong praise for both musical performance and audio fidelity, with no notable complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix, superior balance; reviewers call the sound "off the charts" and note no dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Vibrant, tight first set followed by a slightly more laid‑back but still strong second set; pacing keeps energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry is praised for being "in control" and delivering great tone throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass is highlighted as elevating the music and moving listeners physically.
